summary: After a lost answer the form re-sent its first key with the guest's edits (a fixed email, other times); the server replayed the first request and answered 'sent to' the new address while every email went to the old one.
fix: The key is stored with a hash of the body it was sent with; the same key with another body is refused (409 replay_conflict), and the form gives an edited body a new key.
